correctness.rationale: The tangent cone at a_i e_i gives q_i=2^(1-d) E Phi(-sum_{j!=i}(a_i/a_j)H_j) with independent half-normal H_j. Extreme ratio coupling proves global uniqueness using the omitted normalized leg as strict comparison; Jacobian offdiagonal positive and negative diagonally dominant on any measured principal block proves rank and local ambiguity by implicit function theorem. On bounded log-ratios the omitted-leg weight w_id has an explicit positive Gaussian-event lower bound; an extremal-coordinate maximum principle yields the inverse sup-norm estimate. Independent d=2 planar-angle calculation and d=3 trihedral determinant calculation agreed with Gaussian integral to <9e-16.
